title: Templates
description: Incus VM images registered on owned hosts or usable pool members. Each template pins an exact image fingerprint.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.description: Register an Incus VM image on an owned host or a usable pool member to start sandboxes from it.
empty.retiredDescription: Templates you archive stay listed here, and on the sandboxes that used them.

requirements.title: Image requirements
requirements.image: Use a VM image already in the host’s local Incus store. On an owned host, enter an alias (fingerprints are refused); the host resolves and pins it. On a pool member, enter sha256: followed by the exact 64-character lowercase fingerprint (aliases are refused). Later alias changes do not change a registered revision.
requirements.architecture: The image architecture matches the template (checked by the host at registration).
requirements.agent: The Incus guest agent runs in the VM, so the host can run commands in it.
requirements.identity: The declared guest user exists with that UID, GID, home and shell, and owns a writable home directory.
requirements.tools: sh, setsid, stat, find, mkdir, mv, rm, kill, sync and python3 are installed.
requirements.readiness: Registration checks only the image on the host; the guest agent, user and tools are checked when each sandbox starts, and a sandbox that fails them is not reported ready.
requirements.docsPath: How to qualify an image: {{path}} in the WS Sandbox Proxy source repository.

usabilityHint.archived: Archived templates start no new sandboxes. The revision stays readable for the sandboxes that used it.
usabilityHint.hostDeleting: Its host is pending deletion and accepts no new sandboxes.
usabilityHint.hostRevoked: Its host's credential was revoked. New sandboxes cannot start until the host is enrolled again.
usabilityHint.hostDraining: Its host is draining and accepts no new sandboxes. Undrain the host on the Hosts page.
usabilityHint.hostStale: Its host has not sent a recent heartbeat. New sandboxes cannot start until it reconnects.
usabilityHint.hostOffline: Its host is not connected. New sandboxes cannot start until it runs wssp host run.

archive.title: Archive {{label}}?
archive.description: Prevent new creates through this logical template. Its revisions, host associations and existing sandboxes are retained. This cannot be undone.
archive.blockedInUse: Delete the sandboxes that use this template first (stopped ones count).

register.title: Register a template
register.description: The host looks the image up in its local Incus store and reports its fingerprint and architecture. Nothing is downloaded or built.
register.resultHint: The exact revision is registered. Verify it on other hosts before placing there; existing sandboxes keep their pinned revision.

hostStateHint.draining: This host is draining and accepts no new templates. Undrain it on the Hosts page.
hostStateHint.unavailable: This host cannot check an image now ({{state}}). Start its daemon with wssp host run.

form.noHosts: You have no hosts yet. Enroll one on the Hosts page first.
form.label: Name
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. A slug can have several revisions (one per fingerprint).
form.imageRefHint: For example ubuntu-26.04-dev or local:ubuntu-26.04-dev. Not a content digest.
form.guestHint: The user commands and file transfers run as. The defaults match most cloud images prepared for WS Sandbox Proxy.
form.guestVersionHint: A free-form note, for example the image build date.
form.envsHint: Private JSON string map: up to 64 entries, names 128 UTF-8 bytes, values 4096 bytes, sorted JSON 16384 bytes total. Sandbox and command values override these defaults. HOME, SHELL and TERM are reserved. Changing defaults requires a new revision.
form.sizeHint: Revision defaults: 1–32 vCPUs, 512–65536 MiB in steps of 256, and a 1–2048 GiB default root disk (32 if unchanged). The minimum root disk is the image's own root: sandboxes may not be smaller, and a larger root grows on first boot. Leave it blank to use the default as the minimum. Each append saves a new immutable revision; fields do not inherit another revision.
form.poolImageRefHint: Exact public image identity: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Pool members cannot resolve image aliases.

draft.unknownHost: That host is no longer available. Choose another.
draft.hostUnavailable: The chosen host is not connected, so it cannot check the image.
draft.hostDraining: The chosen host is draining and accepts no new templates.
draft.slug: Use 1–63 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens for the slug.
draft.label: Enter a name of at most 160 characters.
draft.imageRef: Enter an Incus image alias (letters, numbers, : / _ . -, not starting with -). A sha256 digest or fingerprint is not an alias.
draft.guestUid: The UID must be a whole number from 1 to 65534.
draft.guestGid: The GID must be a whole number from 1 to 65534.
draft.guestHome: The home directory must be an absolute path like /home/user, without . or .. parts.
draft.guestShell: The shell must be an absolute path like /bin/bash.
draft.guestVersion: Use at most 64 characters for the guest version.
draft.envs: Enter a valid private environment map within the supported limits.
draft.cpuCount: Enter a whole vCPU count from 1 to 32.
draft.defaultDiskGiB: Enter a whole default root size from 1 to 2048 GiB.
draft.minDiskGiB: Enter a whole minimum from 1 GiB up to the default root size, or leave it blank.
draft.poolImageRef: Enter sha256: followed by the 64-character lowercase image fingerprint.
draft.noPoolMember: Choose a pool and a member to verify the exact image fingerprint.

settings.title: Image settings for {{label}}
settings.description: Placement of image copies, how many snapshots to keep, and extra paths scrubbed on capture.
settings.placementHint: Hosts in shared pools belong to other people; "Owned hosts only" keeps copies of this image off them.
settings.keepHint: Older snapshots under the same tag retire automatically (1–50).
settings.pruneHint: Untagged revisions older than this retire daily. Leave empty to never auto-prune.
settings.scrubPathsHint: One absolute path per line; * matches within the last segment. Never bake secrets into a template.
settings.invalidKeep: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
settings.invalidPrune: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650, or leave it empty.
settings.invalidPaths: Enter up to 64 absolute paths, one per line.
settings.failed: Couldn't save the image settings. Check the paths and try again.

prune.title: Prune {{label}}?
prune.description: Retires untagged revisions outside the newest snapshots kept per tag. Revisions a sandbox uses are kept. Retired revisions can't start new sandboxes.
prune.typePrompt: Type the template slug to confirm

builds.description: A build runs a recipe or Dockerfile in a build VM and captures the result as a new revision of the template.

error.build_step_timeout: A build step ran past its time limit.
error.build_step_host_disconnected: The builder host stayed disconnected past its carry limit, so it stopped the running build step. Start the build again.
error.build_timeout: The build ran past its time limit.
error.build_context_timeout: The build context was not uploaded in time.
error.build_context_mismatch: The uploaded context does not match the checksum sent with the build.
error.build_context_expired: The uploaded build context expired before the build started.
error.build_context_failed: The build context could not be copied into the VM.
error.build_placement_failed: No builder host could start the build VM.
error.build_capture_lease_expired: The VM lease ended before the capture finished.
error.build_authority_lost: The build lost its authority (an access change revoked it).
error.build_host_lost: The builder host went away during the build.

dialog.title: Build {{label}}
dialog.description: Runs the steps in a build VM, then captures the VM as a new revision and moves the tag to it.
dialog.slugHint: Created if it doesn't exist. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
dialog.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (at most 63).
dialog.sourceHint: FROM a template you can use, then RUN, ENV, ARG, WORKDIR, USER root|user and COPY. ADD, CMD, ENTRYPOINT and multi-stage builds are refused.
dialog.tagHint: The tag this build moves when it succeeds.
dialog.tagInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
dialog.argsHint: One NAME=value per line. Each name must be declared with ARG.
dialog.argsInvalid: Line {{line}}: use NAME=value (letters, digits and _; at most 64 args).
dialog.secretWarning: These names look like secrets: {{names}}. Build args and ENV are stored and shown in plain text. Never put secrets in a build.
dialog.egressOpenUnavailable: Open egress isn't available on this server yet.
dialog.egressHint: Open internet runs only on your own hosts; on someone else's host the build gets the allowlist below.
dialog.foreignWarning: Foreign builds are on and this build grants no domains: on another person's host it would have no network access.
dialog.resourcesHint: Leave empty to use the recipe's or the base template's size. The build disk becomes the new template's minimum disk (blank: the base's minimum + 2 GiB), so keep it small; the default sandbox disk is what creates get when they omit a size (blank: the base's default).
